value.message: Unknown Board is on board 99, which is not in Boards. Add board 99 under Boards (type ACTUATOR, or BALL_VALVE for a motorized ball valve), or move the role.
Ball NO is valve 1 on ball valve board 71, which lists active_connectors []. Add 1 to the board's Active Connectors, or move the role.
Ball NO is on ball valve board 71 and is marked NO. A ball valve has no NO/NC — 1 opens it — so set it to NC.
2 actuators are assigned "pwm_fuel" (PWM One, PWM Two) — exactly one must be.
No actuator is assigned "pwm_ox" — the controller has no ox PWM output. Assign one, or clear the other assignment if this rig does not use the PWM controller.
